mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHALLENGE ( ADM_CODE, TITLE, CONTENT, START_DATE, END_DATE, POST_STATUS, PROGRESS_STATUS, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, DELETE_YN ) VALUES ( #{admCode}, #{title}, #{content}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{postStatus}, #{progressStatus}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), false )
mapper.update: UPDATE CHALLENGE SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, START_DATE = #{startDate}, END_DATE = #{endDate}, POST_STATUS = #{postStatus}, PROGRESS_STATUS = #{progressStatus}, DELETE_YN = #{deleteYn}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE CODE = #{code}
mapper.select:
SELECT c.CODE, c.ADM_CODE, c.TITLE, c.CONTENT, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE, c.POST_STATUS, c.PROGRESS_STATUS, c.CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT, c.DELETE_YN, COUNT(ce.MEM_CODE) AS participantCount
FROM CHALLENGE c LEFT JOIN CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce ON c.CODE = ce.CHAL_CODE WHERE c.DELETE_YN = false GROUP BY c.CODE, c.ADM_CODE, c.TITLE, c.CONTENT, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE, c.POST_STATUS, c.PROGRESS_STATUS, c.CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT, c.DELETE_YN ORDER BY participantCount DESC, c.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT c.CODE, c.ADM_CODE, c.TITLE, c.CONTENT, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE, c.POST_STATUS, c.PROGRESS_STATUS, c.CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT, c.DELETE_YN, COUNT(ce.MEM_CODE) AS participantCount FROM CHALLENGE c LEFT JOIN CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce ON c.CODE = ce.CHAL_CODE WHERE c.DELETE_YN = false GROUP BY c.CODE, c.ADM_CODE, c.TITLE, c.CONTENT, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE, c.POST_STATUS, c.PROGRESS_STATUS, c.CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT, c.DELETE_YN ORDER BY c.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.CODE AS code, DATE_FORMAT(c.START_DATE, '%Y.%m.%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(c.END_DATE, '%Y.%m.%d') AS endDate, DATEDIFF(c.END_DATE, NOW()) AS daysLeft, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce WHERE ce.CHAL_CODE = c.CODE AND STATUS = 'JOINED') AS participantCount, c.GOAL AS goal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FEED f WHERE f.CHAL_CODE = c.CODE AND f.MEM_CODE = #{memCode} AND f.DELETE_YN = false) AS proofCount, (DATEDIFF(c.END_DATE, c.START_DATE) + 1) AS totalProofCount, c.POINT_EARNED as pointEarn, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce WHERE ce.CHAL_CODE = c.CODE AND MEM_CODE = #{memCode} AND STATUS = 'JOINED' ) AS isJoined FROM CHALLENGE c WHERE c.CODE = #{code} AND c.DELETE_YN = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHALLENGE_ENTRY( CHAL_CODE, MEM_CODE, STATUS, JOINED_AT ) SELECT #{code}, #{memCode}, 'JOINED', NOW() FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY WHERE CHAL_CODE = #{code} AND MEM_CODE = #{memCode} )
